name: revayat-novel
description: Translate books into Persian with a six-stage multi-agent workflow. A pure-Rust native binary builds Word files with the bundled Vazirmatn font.
suggestedPrompts: Translate this EPUB into Persian and keep its illustrations, footnotes, and chapter order.
Translate this scanned PDF page by page and flag any words the scan leaves uncertain.
Review this Persian Word file against its source and check that its chapter links work.
